message: Residual SWIFT_TESTING_RANGE_ABORT from 071140-capture-flagship-metadata-test-truth-9c42 is now source-isolated. Exact #2805@4456c artifact 9092226121 reran the full Capture suite serially and still aborts, proving this is not parallel-test scheduling. The final serial test started before the fatal is `Capture primary rider language` / `primary Capture flow stays rider-first while Engineering Details retains exact protocol truth`. Its source is TuyaCapturePrimaryLanguageSourceTests.primaryLanguageBoundary(): it independently locates preflightPanel and engineeringDisclosure and constructs primaryStart.lowerBound..<detailsStart.lowerBound without ordering the second lookup. Current app source order makes lowerBound > upperBound, yielding the observed Swift fatal. Minimal truthful repair is a test-source boundary fix: constrain the engineeringDisclosure search to primaryStart.lowerBound..<app.endIndex (or explicitly require marker ordering), with every existing positive/negative rider-language assertion preserved. Treat #2799 metadata truth repair as necessary predecessor evidence and this Range boundary repair as the separate residual package-test closure; neither is physical authority.
